name: Glorifying on Journey
arabic: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رضي الله عنه: ((كُنَّا إِذَا صَعَدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا)).

translations.albanian: Shënohet nga Xhabiri (r.a) , i cili ka thënë: “Kur hipnim përpjetë, merrnim tekbir, thonim All-llahu Ekber, ndërsa kur zbrisnim bënim tesbih, thonim SubhanAll-llah.”
translations.english: Jabir said: Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allaahu 'Akber (Allah is the Most Great) and when we descended we would say Subhaanallaah (Glory is to Allah)
translations.indonesian: Dari Jabir Radhiallahu'anhu, dia berkata: "Kami apabila berjalan naik, membaca takbir, dan apabila kami turun, membaca tasbih." 236 102- DOA MUSAFIR KETIKA MENJELANG SUBUH
